findings:
🟡 [preflight-final-filter-drops-line] CUT/FOLLOW-UP scripts/preflight-release.sh version_in_file (`grep -E "$pat" | grep -vqE "v${VERSION}-(alpha|beta|rc)\.[0-9]"`) filters whole lines, so at the final 3.0.0 cut a legitimate heading or INDEX row that also names a pre-release (e.g. `## v3.0.0 — folds v3.0.0-alpha.2`) is discarded and check 2 or check 4 fails. It fails closed and only matters at the final cut, not alpha.N. Smallest fix: drop the line filter and anchor the final pattern so a `-` cannot follow, e.g. `v${VERSION//./\\.}([^-0-9.]|$)`. Add a semver.test.sh case for a mixed line.
🟡 [u4-break-before-signal-gate] CUT/FOLLOW-UP scripts/probe-unknown.js classify loop: the `else if (RUNGS.indexOf(rung) > maxIdx) break;` for an over-max U2/U3 exits before the signal-gated U4 is reached. Example: a `how` unit with S4 alone (eligible_max U1) that holds a U2 receipt from an earlier round gets `none`, although the plan's U4 predicate (U2 receipt plus S4|S1) holds. It needs signals that change between rounds, so it is rare. Smallest fix: `continue` instead of `break` for over-max non-U4 rungs.
🔵 [golden-default-comment] CUT/FOLLOW-UP hooks/tests/probe-unknown.test.sh golden case 13 says "no --budget-* flags" but passes V3G (`--budget-u4 1`), so that line does not pin the U4 default. The default is still exercised elsewhere: the PIN-only "⇒ U4 experiment" case and the AUTOPILOT_UNKNOWN_LADDER_V3-inert assertion against golden line 2 (u4:1), because no in-range resolver emits unknown_budget_u4. Optional fix: drop `--budget-u4` from that line and regenerate it.
